items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: Well outside of Manny Perez, and Joe Oliver, and Louis Armstrong, them about the only three men that I knew.

ctx.x: Did any other bands ever play them in those days in the dance halls, like they do now? Uh-huh. The Saints go marching in, they play all the time.

Uh-huh. Well, they, they, taking that for real ragged. Well, they do's that, but we never did play nothing like that. They'd copy that from Louis playing it on the record, and they just start to playing it on the dance, in the dance hall, because people would ask them. You see, any place I would play that, ask me for that, I'd tell them I wouldn't play that. So, I never did play it. So, uh, I don't know. Maybe some of them, a lot of them be playing them songs we played. Those hymns. Only thing we played are what…
Oh, who took Roy Evans' place? You say you didn't have a drummer for a while. Who? After Roy Evans died. He left your band, Roy Evans, the drummer?
